blocks.text: PASADENA, California – Thailand’s teenage guitar sensation Nene Royal won the US$1-million top prize on “America’s Got Talent” (AGT), capping a viral run that made the 16-year-old a national celebrity and drew support from across her home country. Rattikarn Amloy — better known by her stage name Nene Royal — was crowned the winner during the live results show on Sept 23, beating nine other finalists after emerging as the clear favorite before the finale.
